description.description: A man attaches a black action camera to the neck of a beige mountain goat. Initially standing on a grassy ledge overlooking a canyon, the goat then begins to traverse an extremely steep and narrow rocky cliff path high in the mountains, with the camera capturing a first-person perspective from the animal's neck. The background features rugged mountain peaks, some with snow, under a blue sky.
